cohort: Adult patients (>18 years) weighing at least 80 kg who underwent 9 major surgical procedures with cefuroxime surgical antimicrobial prophylaxis (SAP) at 142 Swiss hospitals.
finding: Overall, double-dose cefuroxime surgical antimicrobial prophylaxis (SAP) was not consistently associated with a lower surgical site infection (SSI) rate in patients weighing at least 80 kg, though some subgroups showed a lower rate.
